hero.tagline: I build web applications from database to deploy: React interfaces, Ruby on Rails back ends, data in PostgreSQL and PL/SQL, all packaged with Docker and served by Nginx.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a full stack developer based in Rio de Janeiro with a B.Sc. in Computer Science and over 5 years of experience in tech. I like to understand the whole problem: from database modeling to the experience of the person using the screen.

Today I'm the technical lead for a system at Inetum: I build with React and Ruby on Rails, write PL/SQL when business rules live in the database, migrate legacy code to React and run production servers with Docker, Nginx, Red Hat and Windows Server.
Outside of work I turn real problems into projects, like a platform that grades multiple-choice answer sheets from a photo.
